display.purpose: Author name in header. The only display-sized text.

title.purpose: Position titles, section headings. Weight 600 is the hierarchy signal.

body.purpose: All body copy, list items, aside content.

label.purpose: Nav links, metadata, timeline company lines.

mono.purpose: Code blocks only. Never UI labels.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: TL;DR modal only — the single elevated surface in the system.

components.name: Inline Link
components.description: Default link style: transparent bottom border that appears on hover in current text color.
components.css: .ds-link-inline { color: light-dark(#000, #fff); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-link-inline:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Muted Link
components.description: Aside and metadata link variant using muted ink color.
components.css: .ds-link-muted { color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9em; word-break: break-word; hyphens: auto; } .ds-link-muted:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-link-muted:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Muted background chip for tech stack tags and skill markers.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: light-dark(#e7e7e7, #353535); color: light-dark(#000, #fff); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.2em 0.6em; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 0.85em; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: Editorial pull quote with left border, tinted background, and rounded right corner.
components.html: This is the AI-augmented SDLC adopted by Cencosud.
components.css: .ds-blockquote { margin: 1.5em 0; padding: 1em 1.5em; border-left: 4px solid light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); background: light-dark(#f5f5f5, #1f2229); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; font-style: italic; color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-blockquote p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Timeline Item
components.description: Experience entry with left border and typographic 'o' node. The signature component of the system.
components.html:
Engineering Manager

Cencosud - 2023-Present

Led AI-augmented SDLC strategy for +800 developers.
components.css: .ds-timeline-item { position: relative; padding-left: 1.5em; border-left: 0.13em solid light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); margin-left: 0.4em; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-timeline-item::before { content: "o"; height: 1.5em; background: light-dark(#fff, #16181c); position: absolute; left: -0.34em; top: -0.15em; font-size: 1.5em; } .ds-timeline-position { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.2em; font-size: 1.15rem; color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); } .ds-timeline-company { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95em; margin: 0.5em 0; } .ds-timeline-company a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-timeline-company a:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-timeline-desc { font-size: 0.95em; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: TL;DR Trigger
components.description: Inline text-style button that opens the AI summary modal. Reads as a link, not a button.
components.css: .ds-tldr-trigger { background: transparent; color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-tldr-trigger:hover { color: light-dark(#000, #fff); } .ds-tldr-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Uppercase h3 section header — the only text transformation in the system.
components.css: .ds-section-header { text-transform: uppercase; font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 1em 0 0.3em 0; color: light-dark(#000, #fff); line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: TL;DR Dialog
components.description: The only elevated surface in the system. Modal with pill background and the single shadow token.
components.html:
TL;DR Summary

Generated summary content appears here.
components.css: .ds-tldr-dialog { padding: 2em; max-width: 600px; max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 8px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); position: relative; background: light-dark(#e7e7e7, #353535); color: light-dark(#000, #fff); font-family: "Montserrat Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-tldr-dialog::backdrop { background: rgb(189 189 189 / 0.6); } .ds-tldr-title { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-tldr-body { line-height: 1.6; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-tldr-close { position: absolute; top: 1em; right: 1em; background: transparent; color: light-dark(#616161, #abb0c2); border: none; font-size: 1.5em; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; padding: 0; } .ds-tldr-close:hover { color: light-dark(#000, #fff); }

narrative.overview: This is a resume that grew up. It treats the page as a printed document first and a web page second — wide margins, generous whitespace, a single typographic family carrying every role, and an austere monochrome palette where the absence of color is the design statement. The sidebar is the marginalia of an editorial spread; the main column is the article itself. The system supports light and dark modes natively via light-dark(), but neither mode introduces color for branding. Dark mode is a tonal inversion, not a chromatic event. Print is a first-class surface with its own token overrides. Components are deliberately quiet — everything recedes so the content can lead.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome with light-dark() tonal inversion; color is functional, never decorative
Single font family (Montserrat Variable) across all roles; weight + size carry hierarchy
Print-first: pt units, A4 page geometry, suppressed ornamentation in @media print
Flat by default: no shadows except the TL;DR dialog; depth via tonal layering
Two-column editorial layout (aside 25% / main 75% in print), collapses under 900px

rules.name: The No Decoration Rule
rules.body: Color is never used decoratively. The accent appears only where it carries functional meaning. If a surface needs emphasis, use tonal layering or typographic weight — not hue.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Montserrat Variable is the only typeface. Weight and size carry all hierarchy. Introducing a second display family would break the editorial resume contract.

rules.name: The Uppercase Section Rule
rules.body: Section headers (h3.upper) are uppercased. This is the only text transformation in the system and it marks structural divisions.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Shadows appear only on the TL;DR dialog. If a new component needs elevation, use tonal layering or a border — not a shadow.

rules.name: The Squared Default Rule
rules.body: The default radius is 0. Radius is added only to soften functional elements. Large rounded containers would break the editorial document feel.

dos: Do use light-dark() for all color tokens — it is the canonical source of truth for both modes.
Do express hierarchy through font-weight (400 → 600) and size, never through family contrast.
Do use tonal layering (Paper → Paper Pill → Paper Tint) to convey depth without shadows.
Do keep the aside link overflow safe: word-break: break-word; hyphens: auto.
Do test print output in both Chrome and Edge — paginated consistency is a tracked risk.
Do preserve the 1000px max-width container — the editorial measure is intentional.
donts: Don't introduce a second font family for display or body — Montserrat Variable is the only voice.
Don't add shadows to any component except the TL;DR dialog. Flat is the default.
Don't use the accent blue (#0055FF) decoratively — it is functional only.
Don't add large border-radius to containers — the default is squared; radius softens functional elements only.
Don't replace the timeline's typographic 'o' node with an icon or decorative dot — the glyph is the design.
Don't add external libraries beyond package.json without an ADR.
